character.identity: Sage Kashyapa, Aditi’s husband and father of Vamana.
character.anatomy: one distinct face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet; natural adult proportions.
character.continuity: A mature ascetic with restrained grey hair or topknot, simple ochre or cream garments, and a calm, benevolent expression; no unsupported extra limbs or props.
character.style: flat opaque mineral matte pigment with dark drawn contours and painted ochre ornament; no gloss or metallic reflection.
